text:
nina: heads up - parity bug between node and py sdks on tool/function calls. When schema has number | string the node SDK sometimes sends numbers as strings after auth refresh. broke samples/billing-estimator.

omar: can you share minimal repro?

nina: repro: client.callTool('estimate', {units: 5}) -> token refresh -> server sees {units: "5"}. schema allows number | 'unmetered'. validator rejects string-number.

lee: hm we serialise then stash args for retries in auth wrapper; node path used JSON.stringify early, py kept raw.

ci-bot: failing test: samples/billing-estimator e2e 1% tests failing (toolcall-number-union.test.js)

omar: assign @sdk-team. fix: preserve raw args for retries, re-serialize at send-time. add cross-sdk parity matrix tests.

nina: i'll open a small PR with unit + e2e and a canary run. PR #4230.

lee: remember streaming and SSE paths too. add tests for those transports.

ci-bot: issue #6810 filed: "node-sdk: auth-retry coerces numeric fields to string for number|string unions"

sdk-team: acknowledged. will backport to 1.4.x if approved.

nina: updating sample assertions and adding migration note.
